overview_description.description: Goldbridge provides banking and financial operations software focused on real estate businesses. The platform connects FDIC-insured business accounts with property-level sub-ledgers to separate and track funds for each asset or property. Its tools support transaction monitoring, account reconciliation, and allocation of income and expenses across portfolios. Goldbridge also offers smart card functionality to control spending and route charges back to the correct property entities. The system is designed to replace manual spreadsheets and fragmented banking workflows that property managers and real estate finance teams often use. By combining banking, ledger management, and spend controls in one application, Goldbridge aims to simplify compliance and financial reporting for real estate operators and owners.
